Ravi Menon: Quick kickoff for Aurora onboarding. Goals: get 2 pilot flows live, define success metrics for renewal check, and confirm ownership. Elena, Kai, you in?
Elena Soto: In. I'll own enablement + recordings. planning two 30m sessions: integration basics and prompt tuning.
Kai Morgan: I'll take infra + perf baselines. need service account and expected qps from Aurora.
Ravi Menon: Proposed success metrics: 1) 2 flows end-to-end in staging, 2) E2E < 90s, inference p95 < 350ms, 3) <2% integration errors, 4) at least 3 users complete training.
Elena Soto: I'll draft the attendee list and a short FAQ for their PMs.
Kai Morgan: Baseline command I'll run and paste in doc. ETA for baseline: Wed.
OnboardingBot: Created doc https://redwood.company/aurora-onboard. Access: Ravi Menon, Elena Soto, Kai Morgan.
Ravi Menon: Risks to flag: delayed creds, missed sessions, repeated auth errors. propose weekly pulse and a quick exec note if red flags show up.
Elena Soto: Action items: I'll send invites today. Kai: baseline by Wed. Ravi: add success metrics + risk buckets to doc.
Ravi Menon: Thanks team, will update the doc and loop in Aurora contacts after invite sent. :rocket:
